title: Max Area of Island
statement: Return the area of the largest 4-connected island of 1s in a grid of 0s and 1s. An all-water grid has area 0.
hints: This is number of islands, except you return the size of the component instead of 1.
Count cells as you mark them visited.
Track the maximum count. Zero islands means the answer is 0.

approaches.name: DFS size
approaches.explanation: Return the number of cells flooded.

approaches.name: BFS size
approaches.explanation: Same component, counted with a queue.

editorial: Flood each unvisited land cell and add one to the area for every cell you mark. The answer is the maximum area encountered. Marking visited is mandatory, otherwise a cell would be counted by every neighbor.
